question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

My parents have a __fertile__ land in the backyard.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Barren**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"fertile"** means capable of producing abundant vegetation or crops; it often refers to soil that is rich in nutrients. (उपजाऊ)
 
 
• **Example: **The fertile land in the valley is perfect for growing a variety of crops.
 
 
 
• **"Barren" **refers to land that is too poor to produce much or any vegetation; it is the opposite of fertile. (बंजर)
 
 
• **Example: **The barren desert landscape stretched for miles, with hardly any signs of life.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'fertile' **is **'barren'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Barren**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Scanty **(अल्प): Small or insufficient in quantity or amount.
 
 
• **Example:** The rainfall this year has been scanty, affecting the crop yields.
 
 
 
• **Potent **(शक्तिशाली): Having great power, influence, or effect.
 
 
• **Example: **The medicine was potent enough to cure the illness in just a few days.
 
 
 
• **Timid** (डरपोक): Showing a lack of courage or confidence; easily frightened.
 
 
• **Example:** The timid child hesitated to speak in front of the class.
